resources.string: Vogel Vault
Convex row data unavailable
The row read failed. Check the connection and read-token settings, then retry.
Convex read credential rejected
Convex rejected the configured read credential. Re-enter a valid credential; cached financial figures remain hidden.
Convex row reads disabled
The remote-read kill switch is off. Enable remote row reads before retrying.
Convex client not configured
This client has no usable secure Convex deployment URL. Install or configure a build with the approved deployment.
Could not reach Convex
The request did not complete successfully. Check the network connection and retry; stale authorized figures may still be shown.
Convex data rejected
Convex returned an incomplete or malformed payload that this app cannot safely render. Update the app or report the data-contract failure.
Showing stale data
The last successful Convex row response is old. Treat these figures as out of date.
Loading Convex rows
Requesting Convex row tables over HTTP.
No rows returned
Convex returned an authoritative empty result for this view.
Convex read token not accepted
Convex rejected the configured read credential. Cached financial figures are hidden.
Convex row reads are not active
No read token is configured, or remote reads are disabled; this screen cannot distinguish those states. Figures are sample data.
A Convex read token is stored securely.
No Convex read token is stored. Row reads are unconfigured.
Remove stored token
The stored read token could not be removed.
